parameters.toolDescription:
Busca la información de un animal en la base de datos del rancho actual. REQUIERE: identificador (arete SINIIGA, número de fuego, o RFID/electronic_rfid — cualquiera de los tres) y el tenant_id del contexto del usuario. 
Cuando el identificador tenga más de 6 dígitos, cópialo carácter por carácter exactamente como aparece en el mensaje del usuario — no lo redondees, no lo repitas de memoria, no asumas patrones. Verifica que tu copia tenga la misma longitud que el original antes de llamar la herramienta.
Si devuelve más de un registro, detén el flujo y pide al usuario que aclare a cuál animal se refiere usando la categoría o especie.

La respuesta incluye además 'upp' (nombre de la UPP) y 'lote' (nombre del lote). Si vienen vacíos, el animal NO tiene UPP o lote asignado: díselo así al usuario. NUNCA afirmes en qué UPP o lote está un animal si estos campos no vienen en la respuesta.
parameters.query:
SELECT l.id, l.tenant_id, l.rfid_siniiga, l.numero_fuego, l.electronic_rfid, l.species, l.category, l.current_status, l.current_weight_kg,
       pu.ranch_name AS upp, lot.lot_name AS lote
FROM cattle_livestock l
LEFT JOIN production_units pu ON pu.id = l.production_unit_id AND pu.id_company = l.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN production_unit_lots lot ON lot.id = l.lot_id AND lot.id_company = l.tenant_id
WHERE fn_reject_palm_company($2::int)
  AND (l.rfid_siniiga = $1::text OR l.numero_fuego = $1::text OR l.electronic_rfid = $1::text)
  AND l.tenant_id = $2::int
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM user_companies uc
    JOIN users u ON u.email = uc.email
    WHERE u.email = $3::text AND uc.id_company = $2::int AND uc.is_active = true
  )
LIMIT 5;

parameters.toolDescription:
Registers a weaning event for a specific animal. Requires the animal's internal
livestock_id (UUID), which must be resolved FIRST via get_livestock_info before
calling this tool — do not call this tool with a RFID, SINIIGA tag, or fire number,
only with the UUID returned by get_livestock_info. Also requires tenant_id and
user_email from the current session context, same as the other tools.

If the user mentions a weight at the moment of weaning, pass it in weight_kg and it
will be recorded as part of this same event. If no weight is mentioned, do not guess
one — omit weight_kg entirely, the event will still be recorded without weight.

Do not assume weaning_method if the user doesn't specify it; ask, or omit it and it
will default to NATURAL.

WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    $1::int AS tenant_id,
    $2::uuid AS livestock_id,
    $3::date AS weaning_date,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(NULLIF($4::text, 'null'), 'undefined'), 'NATURAL') AS weaning_method,
    $5::text AS reported_by_email,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($6::text, 'null'), 'undefined')::numeric AS weight_kg,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($7::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS notes
),
auth_check AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM params p
  JOIN user_companies uc ON uc.id_company = p.tenant_id AND uc.is_active = true
  JOIN users u ON u.email = uc.email AND u.email = p.reported_by_email
)
SELECT sp.*
FROM params p,
LATERAL sp_register_weaning_event(
    p_id_company        := p.tenant_id,
    p_livestock_id       := p.livestock_id,
    p_weaning_date       := p.weaning_date,
    p_weaning_method     := p.weaning_method,
    p_reported_by_email  := p.reported_by_email,
    p_weight_kg          := p.weight_kg,
    p_notes              := p.notes
) sp
WHERE fn_reject_palm_company($1::int)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth_check);

parameters.toolDescription:
Registers a REQUEST for a livestock mortality (death) event — this does NOT immediately finalize the death record. It creates a pending authorization that an ADMIN/owner must approve from the web panel before the animal's status changes. Requires the animal's identifier — accepts electronic_rfid, rfid_siniiga, or numero_fuego (whichever the user provided; the underlying procedure resolves the identifier itself and rejects ambiguous matches). Also requires tenant_id and user_email from the current session context, same as the other tools.

🛑 CONFIRM BEFORE EXECUTING: Never call this tool in the same turn the user first mentions a death. Repeat back the animal identifier, cause of death, and date, and only call this tool after the user gives an explicit affirmative confirmation in the immediately following turn — same protocol as request_livestock_sale.

causa_mortandad MUST be exactly one of: ENFERMEDAD, ACCIDENTE, DEPREDACIÓN, DESCONOCIDA, NATURAL. If the user's description doesn't clearly map to one of these, ask them to choose — do not guess.

After calling this tool successfully, tell the user their report was submitted for authorization and that an ADMIN/owner of the ranch must approve it TODAY BEFORE 6:00 PM Mexico City time or it will expire automatically — do NOT tell the user the animal has been marked as dead, since that only happens once approved.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(NULLIF($1::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS electronic_rfid,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($2::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS rfid_siniiga,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($3::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS numero_fuego,
    $4::int AS tenant_id,
    $5::jsonb AS payload,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($6::text, 'null'), 'undefined')::uuid AS livestock_id,
    $7::text AS solicitado_por_email
),
auth_check AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM params p
  JOIN user_companies uc ON uc.id_company = p.tenant_id AND uc.is_active = true
  JOIN users u ON u.email = uc.email AND u.email = p.solicitado_por_email
)
SELECT sp.*
FROM params p,
LATERAL sp_solicitar_autorizacion(
    p_electronic_rfid      := p.electronic_rfid,
    p_rfid_siniiga         := p.rfid_siniiga,
    p_numero_fuego         := p.numero_fuego,
    p_tenant_id            := p.tenant_id,
    p_tipo_evento          := 'BAJA_MORTANDAD',
    p_payload              := p.payload,
    p_livestock_id         := p.livestock_id,
    p_solicitado_por_email := p.solicitado_por_email
) sp
WHERE fn_reject_palm_company($4::int)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth_check);

parameters.toolDescription:
LEGACY single-animal sale request. For ANY sale use preview_livestock_sale_order + request_livestock_sale_order instead; use this tool only for a newborn calf without ear tag resolved with find_calf_by_dam (livestock_id).

Registers a REQUEST to sell/check-out (dar de baja por venta) a live animal — this does NOT immediately finalize the sale. It creates a pending authorization that an ADMIN/owner must approve from the web panel before the animal's status changes to VENDIDO. Requires the animal's identifier — accepts electronic_rfid, rfid_siniiga, or numero_fuego. Also requires tenant_id and user_email from the current session context.

🛑 CONFIRM BEFORE EXECUTING: Never call this tool in the same turn the user first mentions a sale. Repeat back the animal identifier (and the sale date and transit guide folio(s), if the user gave them) and only call this tool after the user gives an explicit affirmative confirmation in the immediately following turn — same protocol as log_mortality_event.

After calling this tool successfully, tell the user their sale request was submitted for authorization and that an ADMIN/owner of the ranch must approve it before 23:59 (Mexico City time) of today or it will expire automatically — do NOT tell the user the animal has been sold, since the actual TB/Brucelosis compliance check and status change only happen once approved.

Optional parameters: fecha_evento (YYYY-MM-DD, the day the sale/movement happened) and guia_transito (transit guide folio(s), comma-separated). Pass them ONLY if the user stated them; never invent or infer them. They are stored in the request so the ADMIN sees them when authorizing. In a batch sale, pass the same values on every call.
parameters.query:
WITH inp AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(NULLIF($1::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS electronic_rfid,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($2::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS rfid_siniiga,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($3::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS numero_fuego,
    $4::int AS tenant_id,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($5::text, 'null'), 'undefined')::uuid AS livestock_id,
    $6::text AS solicitado_por_email,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($7::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS fecha_txt,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($8::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS guia_txt
),
params AS (
  SELECT i.*,
    jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
      'fecha_evento', CASE
          WHEN i.fecha_txt IS NULL THEN NULL
          WHEN i.fecha_txt ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' THEN to_char(i.fecha_txt::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
          ELSE (i.fecha_txt || ' (use YYYY-MM-DD)')::date::text
        END,
      'guia_transito', left(trim(i.guia_txt), 40)
    )) AS payload
  FROM inp i
),
auth_check AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM params p
  JOIN user_companies uc ON uc.id_company = p.tenant_id AND uc.is_active = true
  JOIN users u ON u.email = uc.email AND u.email = p.solicitado_por_email
)
SELECT sp.*
FROM params p,
LATERAL sp_solicitar_autorizacion(
    p_electronic_rfid      := p.electronic_rfid,
    p_rfid_siniiga         := p.rfid_siniiga,
    p_numero_fuego         := p.numero_fuego,
    p_tenant_id            := p.tenant_id,
    p_tipo_evento          := 'VENTA',
    p_payload              := p.payload,
    p_livestock_id         := p.livestock_id,
    p_solicitado_por_email := p.solicitado_por_email
) sp
WHERE fn_reject_palm_company($4::int)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth_check);

parameters.toolDescription:
OBSOLETA: no la uses. Usa register_birth_checked, que NO acepta lot_name ni production_unit_name: solo lot_id y production_unit_id tomados de list_lots. Ignora el resto de esta descripción (habla de nombres de lote/UPP que register_birth_checked no tiene).

Location is usually inherited automatically from the dam (production_unit_id, lot_id, paddock_id) if she already has one assigned — you do NOT need to ask the user for these unless the dam has no location on file (in which case, ask for production_unit_id specifically) or the user explicitly wants to override it. lot_id is rarely used in this system today — omit it unless the user specifically mentions a lot.

If the user mentions the UPP or lot BY NAME (e.g. "Pista de Hielo", "lote de pruebas") instead of giving you a resolved UUID, pass that text in production_unit_name / lot_name — the tool will resolve it internally. NEVER put a name into production_unit_id or lot_id, those are UUID-only fields.

🛑 CRÍTICO — cómo reportar el resultado: la respuesta de esta tool es la ÚNICA fuente de verdad. Arma tu confirmación al usuario ÚNICAMENTE con estos campos, tal como vienen en el JSON de respuesta:
- Sexo: (el que el propio usuario indicó, este dato no lo resuelve la tool)
- Madre: dam_id_resolved
- Categoría: category
- UPP asignada: production_unit_name_resolved si viene distinto de null; si viene null, di explícitamente "no se resolvió ninguna UPP" — NUNCA repitas el nombre que el usuario mencionó (ej. "Pista de Hielo") como si fuera un hecho confirmado.
- Lote asignado: lot_name_resolved si viene distinto de null; si viene null, di explícitamente "no se resolvió ningún lote" — NUNCA repitas el nombre que el usuario mencionó (ej. "lote de pruebas") como si fuera un hecho confirmado.
- Estado de la madre: dam_status_warning si viene distinto de null.

PROHIBIDO inventar o inferir nombres de UPP/lote que no vengan en production_unit_name_resolved / lot_name_resolved. Si el usuario mencionó un nombre y la tool no lo confirmó resuelto, dilo explícitamente en vez de darlo por hecho.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    $1::int AS tenant_id,
    $2::text AS calf_sex,
    $3::text AS species,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($4::text, 'null'), 'undefined')::uuid AS dam_id,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($5::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS dam_ear_tag,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($6::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS dam_fire_number,
    $7::date AS birth_date,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($8::text, 'null'), 'undefined')::uuid AS lot_id,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($9::text, 'null'), 'undefined')::uuid AS production_unit_id,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($10::text, 'null'), 'undefined')::uuid AS paddock_id,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($11::text, 'null'), 'undefined')::numeric AS birth_weight_kg,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($12::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS notes,
    $13::text AS reported_by_email,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($14::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS production_unit_name,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($15::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS lot_name
),
auth_check AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM params p
  JOIN user_companies uc ON uc.id_company = p.tenant_id AND uc.is_active = true
  JOIN users u ON u.email = uc.email AND u.email = p.reported_by_email
),
resolved_pu AS (
  SELECT pu.id
  FROM params p
  JOIN production_units pu ON pu.id_company = p.tenant_id
  WHERE p.production_unit_name IS NOT NULL
    AND pu.ranch_name ILIKE '%' || p.production_unit_name || '%'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM companys c WHERE c.id_company = p.tenant_id AND c.company_name ILIKE p.production_unit_name
    )
  LIMIT 1
),
resolved_lot AS (
  SELECT lot.id
  FROM params p
  JOIN production_unit_lots lot ON lot.id_company = p.tenant_id
  WHERE p.lot_name IS NOT NULL AND lot.lot_name ILIKE '%' || p.lot_name || '%'
  LIMIT 1
),
sp_result AS (
  SELECT sp.*
  FROM params p,
  LATERAL sp_register_birth_event(
      p_id_company          := p.tenant_id,
      p_calf_sex            := p.calf_sex,
      p_species             := p.species,
      p_dam_id              := p.dam_id,
      p_dam_ear_tag         := p.dam_ear_tag,
      p_dam_fire_number     := p.dam_fire_number,
      p_birth_date          := p.birth_date,
      p_lot_id              := COALESCE(p.lot_id, (SELECT id FROM resolved_lot)),
      p_production_unit_id  := COALESCE(p.production_unit_id, (SELECT id FROM resolved_pu)),
      p_paddock_id          := p.paddock_id,
      p_birth_weight_kg     := p.birth_weight_kg,
      p_notes               := p.notes,
      p_reported_by_email   := p.reported_by_email
  ) sp
  WHERE fn_reject_palm_company($1::int)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth_check)
)
SELECT
  sp_result.sp
    || jsonb_build_object(
      'production_unit_name_resolved', pu_resolved.ranch_name,
      'lot_name_resolved', lot_resolved.lot_name
    ) AS sp
FROM sp_result
LEFT JOIN production_units pu_resolved
  ON pu_resolved.id = (sp_result.sp->>'production_unit_id_resolved')::uuid
LEFT JOIN production_unit_lots lot_resolved
  ON lot_resolved.id = (sp_result.sp->>'lot_id_resolved')::uuid;

parameters.toolDescription:
Finds calves without any physical identifier (no ear tag, fire brand, or chip) born from a specific dam in the last 90 days — used when the user wants to report mortality/sale for a newborn that hasn't been tagged yet, since they can't give you a UUID by voice. Identify the dam by electronic_rfid, rfid_siniiga, or numero_fuego (whichever the user mentioned).

If this returns exactly ONE calf, use its "id" field as the livestock_id parameter when calling log_mortality_event or request_livestock_sale — do NOT ask the user to repeat it, you already have it from this tool's response.

If this returns MULTIPLE calves, list them to the user (sex, birth date, weight) and ask them to pick one before proceeding — never guess which one they mean.

If this returns ZERO calves, tell the user no untagged calf was found for that dam in the last 90 days — the animal might already have an identifier (try get_livestock_info instead) or be older than 90 days.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    $1::int AS tenant_id,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($2::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS dam_electronic_rfid,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($3::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS dam_rfid_siniiga,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($4::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS dam_numero_fuego,
    $5::text AS user_email
),
auth_check AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM params p
  JOIN user_companies uc ON uc.id_company = p.tenant_id AND uc.is_active = true
  JOIN users u ON u.email = uc.email AND u.email = p.user_email
),
dam AS (
  SELECT cl.id
  FROM cattle_livestock cl, params p
  WHERE cl.tenant_id = p.tenant_id
    AND (
      (p.dam_electronic_rfid IS NOT NULL AND cl.electronic_rfid = p.dam_electronic_rfid)
      OR (p.dam_rfid_siniiga IS NOT NULL AND cl.rfid_siniiga = p.dam_rfid_siniiga)
      OR (p.dam_numero_fuego IS NOT NULL AND cl.numero_fuego = p.dam_numero_fuego)
    )
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT cl.id, cl.category, cl.current_status, be.birth_date, be.calf_sex, cl.current_weight_kg
FROM cattle_livestock cl
JOIN birth_events be ON be.calf_id = cl.id
JOIN params p ON cl.tenant_id = p.tenant_id
WHERE fn_reject_palm_company($1::int)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth_check)
  AND be.dam_id = (SELECT id FROM dam)
  AND cl.rfid_siniiga IS NULL
  AND cl.numero_fuego IS NULL
  AND cl.electronic_rfid IS NULL
  AND be.birth_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days')
ORDER BY be.birth_date DESC;

Descripción: Cuenta animales del rancho actual, con filtros opcionales por lote,
UPP, categoría, especie o estatus. Úsala para preguntas tipo "cuántos animales
hay en X", nunca inventes un número — si la consulta regresa 0, dilo tal cual.
Parámetros (todos opcionales excepto tenant_id, inyectado silenciosamente):
  - tenant_id (contexto de sesión, obligatorio)
  - lot_name (texto libre, ej. "El Triunfo")
  - production_unit_name (texto libre, ej. "La Bendición")
  - category (ej. BECERRO, VACA)
  - current_status (default ACTIVO si no se especifica)
  - species
Operación: SELECT read-only, sin confirmación previa (rutinario, como
get_livestock_info). Devuelve conteo total + desglose por categoría.
⚠️ IMPORTANTE sobre production_unit_name: este campo es para subdivisiones
INTERNAS del rancho actual (ej. "UPP Ficticia de Pruebas"), NUNCA para el
nombre de la empresa/rancho ya seleccionado al iniciar sesión (ese nombre
ya está implícito en tenant_id — nunca lo repitas como production_unit_name).
Si el usuario menciona el nombre de su empresa/rancho completo (el mismo
que aparece en su selector de entorno al hacer login), OMITE este parámetro
por completo — no es una UPP interna, es el tenant mismo.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    $1::int  AS tenant_id,
    $2::text AS user_email,
    NULLIF($3::text, 'null') AS lot_name,
    NULLIF($4::text, 'null') AS production_unit_name,
    NULLIF($5::text, 'null') AS category,
    NULLIF($6::text, 'null') AS current_status
)
SELECT l.category, l.current_status, COUNT(*) AS total,
       SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS grand_total
FROM cattle_livestock l
LEFT JOIN production_unit_lots lot ON lot.id = l.lot_id
LEFT JOIN production_units pu ON pu.id = l.production_unit_id
CROSS JOIN params p
WHERE fn_reject_palm_company($1::int)
  AND l.tenant_id = p.tenant_id
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM user_companies uc
    JOIN users u ON u.email = uc.email
    WHERE u.email = p.user_email AND uc.id_company = p.tenant_id AND uc.is_active = true
  )
  AND (
    (p.lot_name IS NOT NULL AND lot.lot_name ILIKE '%' || p.lot_name || '%')
    OR (
      p.lot_name IS NULL AND p.production_unit_name IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companys c WHERE c.id_company = p.tenant_id AND c.company_name ILIKE p.production_unit_name)
      AND pu.ranch_name ILIKE '%' || p.production_unit_name || '%'
    )
    OR (p.lot_name IS NULL AND (
      p.production_unit_name IS NULL
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companys c WHERE c.id_company = p.tenant_id AND c.company_name ILIKE p.production_unit_name)
    ))
  )
  AND (p.category IS NULL OR l.category = p.category)
  AND (
    (p.current_status IS NOT NULL AND l.current_status = p.current_status)
    OR (p.current_status IS NULL AND l.current_status NOT IN ('VENDIDO', 'FINALIZADO', 'BAJA_DEPURACION_DATOS'))
  )
GROUP BY l.category, l.current_status
ORDER BY l.category, l.current_status;

parameters.toolDescription:
Tool: register_livestock_purchase
Descripción: Da de alta un animal COMPRADO (no nacido en el rancho) en cattle_livestock.
No requiere autorización previa (solo las bajas la requieren).
Parámetros (tenant_id y user_email inyectados silenciosamente del contexto de sesión):
  - species (obligatorio, ej. BOVINO)

    la columna no acepta NULL.)
  - rfid_siniiga (identificador arete/RFID si el usuario lo dio, opcional)
  - birth_date (si se conoce, YYYY-MM-DD, opcional)
  - current_weight_kg (OPCIONAL — inclúyelo ÚNICAMENTE si el usuario declaró un número
    de kilos explícito, ej. "pesa 120kg". PROHIBIDO estimar, calcular o inventar un peso
    a partir de la edad, especie, categoría o cualquier otra señal. Si no hay un número
    explícito de kilos en el mensaje del usuario, omite este parámetro por completo.
    Este campo es 100% OPCIONAL a nivel de base de datos — el INSERT nunca falla por
    no tener peso. NUNCA le digas al usuario que el peso es obligatorio ni te niegues
    a registrar la compra por falta de este dato.)
  - purchase_price (obligatorio)
  - seller_name (obligatorio)
  - production_unit_name (UPP destino, opcional)
  - lot_name (lote destino, opcional)
  - purchase_date (YYYY-MM-DD, default hoy si se omite)
  - notes (opcional)
Operación: INSERT en cattle_livestock, current_status queda en ACTIVO.
Precio/vendedor/fecha de compra se guardan en metadata (jsonb).
🛑 CRÍTICO: Si la respuesta de esta tool viene VACÍA (sin filas), NUNCA confirmes el registro al usuario. Dile explícitamente que el registro falló. Las causas posibles son: (1) business_model no es exactamente CRIA, ENGORDA o REPRODUCCION, o (2) el arete/rfid_siniiga que diste ya pertenece a otro animal de esta empresa (duplicado). Si sospechas duplicado, usa find_livestock_by_criteria con ese arete para confirmarlo y dile al usuario qué animal ya lo tiene. Nunca inventes una confirmación usando los datos que tú le pasaste a la tool.
🛑 CRÍTICO: NUNCA inventes, estimes ni calcules current_weight_kg. Un animal registrado sin peso explícito del usuario DEBE quedar sin ese dato (NULL) — se completa después con la tool de pesaje (log_cattle_weight) cuando se pese físicamente. Inventar un peso genera datos falsos en el sistema.
parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    $1::int AS tenant_id,
    $2::text AS user_email,
    $3::text AS species,
    $4::text AS category,
    UPPER($5::text) AS business_model,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($6::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS rfid_siniiga,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($7::text, 'null'), 'undefined')::date AS birth_date,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($8::text, 'null'), 'undefined')::numeric AS current_weight_kg,
    $9::numeric AS purchase_price,
    $10::text AS seller_name,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($11::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS production_unit_name,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($12::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS lot_name,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($13::text, 'null'), 'undefined')::date AS purchase_date,
    NULLIF(NULLIF($14::text, 'null'), 'undefined') AS notes
),
auth_check AS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM params p
  JOIN user_companies uc ON uc.id_company = p.tenant_id AND uc.is_active = true
  JOIN users u ON u.email = uc.email AND u.email = p.user_email
),
duplicate_check AS (
  -- Blocks the insert if the given rfid_siniiga already identifies another
  -- animal in this tenant, in ANY of the three tag columns (a physical tag
  -- can't belong to two animals, regardless of which column it's stored in).
  SELECT 1
  FROM params p
  JOIN cattle_livestock cl ON cl.tenant_id = p.tenant_id
  WHERE p.rfid_siniiga IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      cl.rfid_siniiga = p.rfid_siniiga
      OR cl.electronic_rfid = p.rfid_siniiga
      OR cl.numero_fuego = p.rfid_siniiga
    )
),
resolved_lot AS (
  SELECT lot.id, lot.production_unit_id
  FROM params p
  JOIN production_unit_lots lot ON lot.id_company = p.tenant_id
  WHERE p.lot_name IS NOT NULL AND lot.lot_name ILIKE '%' || p.lot_name || '%'
  LIMIT 1
),
resolved_pu AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT pu.id
      FROM params p
      JOIN production_units pu ON pu.id_company = p.tenant_id
      WHERE p.production_unit_name IS NOT NULL AND pu.ranch_name ILIKE '%' || p.production_unit_name || '%'
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    (SELECT production_unit_id FROM resolved_lot)
  ) AS id
)
INSERT INTO cattle_livestock (
  id, tenant_id, species, category, business_model, current_status,
  rfid_siniiga, birth_date, current_weight_kg,
  production_unit_id, lot_id, metadata, created_at
)
SELECT
  gen_random_uuid(), p.tenant_id, p.species, p.category, p.business_model, 'ACTIVO',
  p.rfid_siniiga, p.birth_date, p.current_weight_kg,
  (SELECT id FROM resolved_pu), (SELECT id FROM resolved_lot),
  jsonb_build_object(
    'source', 'COMPRA',
    'purchase_price', p.purchase_price,
    'seller_name', p.seller_name,
    'purchase_date', COALESCE(p.purchase_date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Mexico_City')::date),
    'notes', p.notes
  ),
  now()
FROM params p
WHERE fn_reject_palm_company($1::int)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auth_check)
  AND p.business_model IN ('CRIA', 'ENGORDA', 'REPRODUCCION')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM duplicate_check)
RETURNING id, rfid_siniiga, category, current_status, business_model;

only the ones the user gave you. species must be one of: BOVINO, BUFALO,
BORREGO, EQUIDO. category must match the exact catalog value (YEGUA,
CABALLO, POTRO, POTRANCA, VACA, TORO, NOVILLO, NOVILLONA, BECERRO, BECERRA,
BUFALA, BUFALO, BUCERRO, BUCERRA, BORREGO, BORREGA, CABALLO_CASTRADO,
BECERRO_TORETE — ask the user if unsure which one applies, never guess).
current_status must be one of: ACTIVO, EN_TRANSITO, VENDIDO, BAJA_MORTANDAD,
PREÑADA, VACÍA, DESARROLLO, RIESGO, FINALIZADO, CUARENTENA,
BAJA_DEPURACION_DATOS.

🛑 CRÍTICO — cómo usar el resultado (la tool nunca decide por ti, tú decides
con base en total_matches):
- Si total_matches = 1: usa el id/rfid_siniiga de ese único resultado para
  la acción que el usuario pidió.
- Si total_matches = 0: dile al usuario que no encontraste ningún animal
  con esos criterios — no inventes un identificador ni asumas otro animal.
- Si total_matches > 1: NUNCA elijas uno al azar ni asumas cuál quiso

    AND (p.species IS NULL OR l.species = p.species)
    AND (p.category IS NULL OR l.category = p.category)
    AND (p.current_status IS NULL OR l.current_status = p.current_status)
    AND (p.lot_name IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM production_unit_lots lot

    AND (p.production_unit_name IS NULL

                     AND translate(c.company_name, 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑáéíóúüñ', 'AEIOUUNaeiouun') ILIKE '%' || translate(p.production_unit_name, 'ÁÉÍÓÚÜÑáéíóúüñ', 'AEIOUUNaeiouun') || '%')

Approves or rejects a PENDING request, given its request_id (get it first with list_pending_requests). The database enforces that only an active ADMIN of this company can resolve requests; never assume the user is an ADMIN.

SALES (VENTA) CANNOT BE APPROVED FROM CHAT: the sale price is captured only in the web panel when an administrator approves it. From chat a VENTA request can only be REJECTED (with reason). If the user wants to approve a sale, tell them to do it in the web panel. Mortality requests (BAJA_MORTANDAD) can be approved or rejected here.

decision must be exactly one of:
- APROBADO: approve a BAJA_MORTANDAD request. The final status change of the animal is applied automatically.
- RECHAZADO: reject a VENTA or BAJA_MORTANDAD request. The animal keeps its current status. A reason (notas) is MANDATORY: ask the user for it if missing, never invent one.
Never use APROBADO_CON_EXCEPCION from chat. If the user asks for a sanitary exception, tell them an administrator must handle it from the web panel.

CONFIRM BEFORE EXECUTING: repeat back the animal identifier, the request type and the decision (and the reason, if any), and only call this tool after an explicit affirmative answer in the next turn.

If the result has code OWN_REQUEST, the request was created by this same user: do NOT report a failure; tell the user that their own request is cancelled, not rejected, and follow the cancel flow (cancel_pending_request) with a new summary and confirmation.

If the tool returns an error, relay it in plain Spanish and never claim success: user is not an ADMIN of this company (only an administrator can approve or reject), rejection without reason, a sale cannot be approved without its sale data (approve it in the web panel), request already resolved/cancelled/expired, or request not found in this company. WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    elem ->> 'identifier'    AS identifier,
    elem ->> 'raw_diagnosis' AS raw_diagnosis,
    CASE WHEN (elem ->> 'raw_diagnosis') ILIKE 'PRE%ADA%' THEN 'PREÑADA' ELSE 'VACÍA' END AS result,
    CASE WHEN (elem ->> 'raw_diagnosis') ILIKE 'PRE%ADA%'
         THEN (substring(elem ->> 'raw_diagnosis' FROM '(\d+)\s*MES'))::int * 30
         ELSE NULL
    END AS gestation_days
  FROM jsonb_array_elements($5::jsonb) AS elem

🛑 Es TODO O NADA: si CUALQUIER renglón tiene problema (animal no encontrado, identificador ambiguo, animal vendido o muerto, animal repetido en el lote, renglón sin identifier o sin raw_diagnosis, o un diagnóstico que no se reconoce: DIAGNOSIS_UNRECOGNIZED, o que mezcla PREÑADA con VACÍA/condición: DIAGNOSIS_CONFLICT) regresa status 'rejected' con 'issues' por renglón (index, identifier, code, message; los ambiguos traen 'candidates') y NO se guarda ninguno. (4) vet_flag en un resultado: POSTPARTUM (código RP, recién parida) o UNFIT (NO APTO, no apta para reproducción); muéstralo con la palabra original que dictó el usuario. Si el resultado trae rp_without_registered_birth = true, esa vaca no tiene parto registrado cerca de la fecha: sugiere registrarlo, pregunta primero y NUNCA lo registres por tu cuenta. (5) "MATRIZ OCUPADA" significa preñada. Los significados de RP, NR, NO APTO y MATRIZ OCUPADA los confirmó el capataz del rancho, NO un veterinario: nunca digas que un veterinario los confirmó.
